gbrain wouldn't give the saved note back. It refused the lookup with "requester_scope_required" because this gbrain connection isn't tied to any member, so personal notes saved through it can't be read back. The fix needs someone with admin access to the gbrain server. The command it suggested is:

  gbrain auth rescope --token <this connection's token> --member '<MEMBER>'

Running that is the brain owner's decision. Until it's fixed, notes saved to gbrain this way can't be relied on for reminders.
